text:
Maria Chen: Quick heads-up — rate schedule v2026.3 deployed last night. There's a live POC with HealthTech (POC id: HT-842) that started under v2026.1 pricing. We need a short-term alignment so the field doesn't have to re-risk the POC mid-run.

Josh Patel: Can you summarize the delta? which SKUs moved and how big of a hit is it for the POC? :eyes:

Maria Chen: Main change: embedding-unit rounding and a tiny uplift on the dedicated reserved SKU for high-throughput. Rough snippet from the diff: 
```
- sku: embed.standard 
  price_per_k: $0.65
+ sku: embed.standard 
  price_per_k: $0.72
- sku: ded.gpu.s1 
  price_hour: $12.50
+ sku: ded.gpu.s1 
  price_hour: $13.00
```
POC is expected to consume ~300k embed units/day — that ~\u002420/day delta but client is price sensitive (proof-of-value).

Nina Gomez: Is grandfathering an option? The POC signed SOW referencing v2026.1 pricing explicitly. If we grandfather, do we set an explicit expire date?

Kevin O'Leary: We should avoid a full repricing mid-POC. Two options: (1) temporary credit to neutralize delta until the POC end date (2026-06-10) or (2) apply old SKU rates for commits signed before deploy. Which is easier from ops?

Dana (Deal Desk): Ops Bot — can you confirm whether HT-842 has an executed SOW tied to commit windows? :deal-desk:  
Ops Bot: HT-842: SOW received 2026-05-02; no committed reserved capacity; POC term 2026-05-05 to 2026-06-10. No prior rate lock flag present.

Dana (Deal Desk): Ok. Deal desk prefer a temporary credit (option 1) for POCs under active SOWs when a rate schedule patch lands mid-run. To fast-track this I need: 1) short justification (one line), 2) POC end date, 3) estimated delta amount, 4) approver (revenue owner). Please fill this template and drop back here.

Maria Chen: Template filled: 
- justification: POC began under v2026.1, mid-run ratepatch causes client churn risk
- end_date: 2026-06-10
- est_delta: \u0024~560 total (projected)
- approver: Josh Patel (rev owner)

Josh Patel: Approve on my end for a temporary credit up to \u0024600. Dana — please route to finance + legal for a quick sign-off. We need messaging to the customer that nothing changes in invoice yet; we'll apply an adjustment credit post-POC.

Eve Legal: Quick ask — ensure we include the credit as a one-time adjustment; do not amend SOW unless customer requests. I'll clear language by EOD if finance signs off.

Dana (Deal Desk): Noted. I'm filing the deal desk ticket now and flagging it as expedited. Expected turnaround 24 hours. If finance wants a JO (journal override) code, ping me. :thumbsup:

Ops Bot: rate-schedule v2026.3 deploy note: "patch: embed rounding + ded.s1 price uplift" — deploy completed 2026-05-14 02:12 UTC

Maria Chen: Thanks all. Two asks before we close this thread: (1) Can ops add a tag on HT-842 to avoid automated billing alerts for the delta? (2) Can we capture this flow as a one-paragraph SOP for future POCs?

Dana (Deal Desk): I'll add the billing-exempt tag now and draft the SOP snippet in the deal ticket. Will paste back here when done.

Eve Legal: I'll drop the one-liner for finance/legal wording into the ticket in ~2 hrs.

Kevin O'Leary: Great — appreciate the quick turnaround team.
